title: P0 next session: restore bd notes erased by `bd update --notes`; link .beads/PRIME.md
description:
HOW IT WAS FOUND (DAS-Backup-Manager, 2026-10-04): `bd update <id> --notes "..."` REPLACES the whole notes field; `--append-notes` adds an entry. Every log entry written with --notes silently erased the one before it. It surfaced when a read-back of operator decisions recorded minutes earlier (DAS bd 8249) came back missing. bd keeps every version in Dolt (`bd history <id>`), and every committed export keeps one in git: the audit found 35 erased entries on 22 issues there, back to 2026-05 (operator decisions, proofs, diagnoses).
HOW IT WAS FIXED THERE: every entry restored oldest-first, each marked '[restored ...]', ahead of the unchanged current note (DAS commit 5596da7); proven: new value = restored entries + the exact previous value on 22/22 fields, 35/35 entries absent before and present after, live audit 22 fields -> 0. The tool is now ~/.claude/scripts/bd-notes-recover.py (tested both ways on a throwaway bd project, including a write that silently does nothing -> FAIL, exit 2). The house prompt ~/.claude/templates/PRIME.md and ~/.claude/rules/beads.md were corrected the same day.
THIS PROJECT, measured read-only 2026-10-04 13:00 CDT: 1 issue read, 0 erased entries found. Repo: PUBLIC. .beads/PRIME.md: ABSENT (bd default prompt injected each session).
DO AT THE START OF THE NEXT SESSION:
1. `~/.claude/scripts/bd-notes-recover.py audit .` (read-only; exit 1 = erased entries found).
2. If any: `~/.claude/scripts/bd-notes-recover.py restore .` (dry run), then `~/.claude/scripts/bd-notes-recover.py restore . --apply` — it re-reads each field before writing, reads every write back and re-audits; it must end RESTORED AND VERIFIED (exit 0). Then commit the export (.beads/issues.jsonl).
3. Link the house prompt, kept LOCAL (public repo: never commit a home-dir symlink): `ln -s ~/.claude/templates/PRIME.md .beads/PRIME.md && echo .beads/PRIME.md >> .git/info/exclude`; verify `bd prime | grep -c append-notes` prints 1 and `git status` stays clean.
4. From now on: `bd update <id> --append-notes "<date> ..."` for every log entry; `--notes` only to rewrite a field on purpose. Existence checks are three commands (beads.md): `bd search` matches titles and ids only; descriptions need `bd list --all --desc-contains "<word>" --limit 0`.
CLOSE WHEN: the audit exits 0 (after a verified restore if one was needed), the link is in place and `bd prime` shows the --append-notes line. Then delete the P0 block at the top of .claude-checkpoint-notes.md.
